visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white sleeveless top, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a small black DJI microphone near her mouth. The background is a clean white wall with soft shadows. (2) The scene cuts to a gym environment with dark grey walls and fitness equipment. The woman, wearing a grey sports bra, is seen from a back-view perspective performing a lat pulldown exercise on a cable machine. Metal weights and racks are visible in the background. (3) In a kitchen setting, the woman wears a light-colored t-shirt and yellow rubber gloves while washing a white bowl in a sink. A coffee machine and kitchen utensils are visible on the counter behind her. (4) The woman is seated indoors, looking down at her smartphone with a focused expression. The lighting is soft and natural. (5) Transition to a retail store with bright artificial lighting. Shelves are filled with red and purple boxes of Megrhythm steam eye masks. A person's hand reaches out to select a box from the display. (6) On an airplane, the woman wears a black face mask and a purple hoodie. She removes an eye mask from its packaging and places it over her eyes while seated in a standard economy seat with a grey headrest. (7) Back in an indoor room, the woman holds three different colored boxes of eye masks: red, green, and brown. She demonstrates how to tear open an individual packet and shows the white fabric mask inside. (8) Detailed shots of the eye mask follow, showing its textured surface and the ear straps. She demonstrates putting it on while lying down in a dark bedroom on a silk pillow.

(2) As the speaker transitions to describing her busy lifestyle, the vocal pacing becomes slightly more energetic. The BGM remains a consistent background layer. A faint 'plastic rustling' SFX is heard as she handles packaging. (3) The narration continues with high articulation as the speaker lists specific ingredients. The BGM maintains a positive, major-mode tonality. The interplay between the voice and the light instrumental track creates a professional yet relatable mood. (4) In the middle phase, the vocal tone becomes more soft and soothing, matching the theme of relaxation. The BGM tracks the vocal closely without overpowering it. Incidental fabric rustling sounds are captured clearly. (5) The final phase features a slightly higher vocal arousal during the call to action. The BGM concludes with a clean fade-out. The overall mix is well-balanced with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
